blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–The remaining members of Team Philippines in Aichi-Nagoya look to advance their campaigns Thursday, October 1, as the Asian Games 2026 enter their final three full days of competition. Alex Eala and the Alas Pilipinas women eye spots in the gold medal matches of tennis and beach volleyball, respectively, as they see action in the semifinals. Filipino bets also begin their campaigns in jiu-jitsu, rugby sevens and taekwondo on Thursday.
